status: Owner refinements incorporated before specification baseline freeze

overrides.requirement: Time travel is a cornerstone: reach any requested point in the available world history, spanning generated prehistory and recorded lived history, with consistent reconstruction, persistent identity and explicit branching; checkpoints accelerate access rather than limiting destinations to selected eras. Supported future-state travel remains governed by explicit simulation and branch rules.
overrides.status: Owner clarified unrestricted historical destination intent; implementation qualification pending

additions.requirement: Support persistent vertical construction and excavation with stacked building floors, subfloors, tunnels and connected multidimensional spaces; represent physical elevation separately from realms/interiors, with coherent collision, traversal, support, visibility, occupancy and streaming.

Provide full mining and integrated fortress construction in ordinary play: substance hardness, tool and skill suitability, seeded mineral deposits, ore extraction, refining/alloys and smithing into weapons, armor, tools, parts and structures, with real labor, resources, hazards and persistent terrain edits.

Deeply integrate foraging, farming, herbal teas, hot springs and enchantments with habitats, seasons, cultivation/harvest, preparation, water/heat/material qualities, character effects, care, facilities and shared production graphs.

Apply damage, deterioration and weathering to applicable actors, objects, vehicles, terrain and structures from both elapsed exposure/use and discrete events; preserve causal condition history, functional consequences, readable presentation and meaningful maintenance, repair or replacement.

Simulate NPC birth, maturation, marriage/partnership, family/household change, aging and death with persistent individual identity, applicable species/cultural rules, care, relationships, memories, custody, inheritance and consequences for surviving characters and stories.

Simulate power structures and hierarchies through persistent institutions, offices, authority, jurisdiction, appointment/election/inheritance or contested succession, delegation, obligations and personal allegiances; lifecycle and world events must change actual governance, resources and behavior.

Keep default presentation and controls approachable like a classic Chrono Trigger-style JRPG despite the deep simulation; progressively reveal relevant mechanisms, properties, explanations, forecasts and advanced choices through actual skill and knowledge progression, while preserving essential hazard/cost readability, scoped knowledge and optional simple views.
additions.status: Owner reaffirmed original vision; implementation and human acceptance unverified

additions.requirement: Give NPCs persistent desires, motivations, likes and dislikes that influence actual choices, relationships, work, ambitions, dialogue and dreams alongside needs, beliefs, obligations and changing world conditions; preferences are contextual and can evolve through experience.

Support NPC dreams and skill-, power- or class-enabled entry into dream realms, alongside distinct planes of existence inspired by Minecraft Nether and D&D ethereal concepts; preserve subjective knowledge, dreamer/body/visitor identity, planar rules, bounded entry/exit, time and resource accounting, interruption and persistent consequences.

Make inter-town trade, changing local resource/item prices, buying in one settlement and selling in another, and guarding actual trade caravans meaningful early-to-mid-game play; account for stock, demand, knowledge, cargo, travel cost, risk, contracts and persistent outcomes.
additions.status: Owner pacing and economy direction; implementation unverified

additions.requirement: Integrate castle, town, fortress, crypt and dungeon construction seamlessly with settlement growth, territorial claims, institutions, nation-building, diplomacy, political events, defense and the lives/actions of inhabitants; construction and governance use the same persistent world.

Support good, evil, neutral and lawful/chaotic alignment concepts through coherent original character and world rules; distinguish individual ethics/choices, reputation, cultural judgment and explicit cosmic or divine commitments, allowing change without species-determined fate.

Integrate art, graphics, animation, expressive performance and narrative with every supported gameplay domain through explicit authoritative state-to-feedback-to-action contracts, readable novice and expert views, interruption/continuity, persistent consequences and native human acceptance.

Provide arbitrary historical-time addressing and reconstruction across the available generated and lived chronology, retaining causal history, versioned generators/events, prior world mutations and identities; bound preparation work without silently replacing a requested instant with a checkpoint, and make historical changes branch-safe for co-op.

Apply lessons from the local roguelike projects and Jaquays-style nonlinear design to procedural dungeons, locations, towns, castles and connected spaces: meaningful loops, multiple entrances, vertical connections, landmarks, alternate skill/social routes and causal history, validated on realized geometry and player choices rather than graph counts alone.

Integrate skills, tools, powers and cooperative combinations into real-time exploration/action puzzles inspired by Sea of Stars and Zelda, with authoritative movement/triggers, persistent world consequences, alternative solutions and accessible controls; retain Wait-style combat and coherent puzzle/hazard timing at encounter boundaries.

Provide a broad extensible skill and profession catalog including fishing, hunting, cooking, knitting, writing, acting and acrobatics as well as all previously required disciplines; give supported skills actual actions, learning, costs, outcomes, sprite performances and uses in puzzles, quests, narrative, society or production rather than decorative labels.

Support Sherlock-style mysteries and deduction alongside spatial/action puzzles: actual incidents, motives, clues, testimony, uncertain beliefs, hypotheses and supported investigations lead to accountable solutions and consequences; preserve knowledge boundaries and alternative evidence routes for solvable states, with truthful failure, cold-case or changed continuations when permitted world actions make resolution impossible.

Populate realistically scaled towns and cities with persistent residents, visitors and NPCs traveling between settlements; traveling merchants and caravans bring actual goods, and connected sewers, caves, crypts, chapel substructures and parallel/shadow-plane spaces participate in coherent location design.

Rate procedural challenges and composite encounters, quests, obstacles and puzzles using explicit difficulty/DC and capability, knowledge, resource, party and timing requirements; validate smooth available advancement routes from supported starting states, maintain understandable recovery/continuation options after world changes, and permit optional harder routes, shortcuts and difficulty-gated dead ends.

Make time and progression central to logical advancement across events, areas, historical instants and parallel/alternate planes, taking inspiration from Majora's Mask schedules and learned opportunities without imposing a universal reset or terminal date; progression validation must consider temporal availability and knowledge as well as spatial reachability.

Identify and implement complementary cross-system synergies and supported combinations up front, making gameplay domains seamlessly share actors, resources, time, causality, progression, art, animation and narrative; validate representative composite situations and explicitly detect contradictory or unsupported combinations.

Support lasting injuries including loss of eyes or limbs, with appropriate restorative spells able to heal the supported injury when their declared conditions are met; serious permanent loss is rare, occasional scars are more common, and anatomy, senses, equipment, actions, relationships, persistence and sprite presentation respond coherently.
additions.status: Owner injury severity and healing direction; frequency requires human playtest acceptance
